shared_elements: human figure(s) rendered in low relief on an upright slab
curved/arcing linear motifs above or across the figure
division of the surface into upper and lower zones
justification: Both surfaces carry human presence and incised discs and arcs in shallow relief on an upright slab, and both loosely divide the field into an upper and lower zone, but these are generic to almost any relief-bearing stone. A shows a narrative multi-figure scene in horizontal registers with seated persons in profile flanking an offering table plus rows of script signs, whereas B is a single frontal, radically schematic anthropomorphic body whose whole outline is the figure, with concentric circles and curved bands as body ornament rather than as separate depicted objects.
